sermon.title: Authentic Progressive Christians - April 28, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: Real progress in Christ’s kingdom is the reverse of the world’s: the last are first and the great serve. The authentic progressive Christian lets the world decrease and Christ increase, flees immorality and drunkenness, refuses dishonest trade with the cross, and lets God break him like a war horse for endurance. Those who wait on the Lord are renewed, as Peter and Cornelius found.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Editor notes: He cites “Romans 12:12” for “do not be conformed” (12:2); left as said and linked to 12:2. The recording places the message first and a worship set after it (~46:37).

faqs.question: Are there guests?
faqs.answer: Yes; it’s good to have them.

faqs.question: Do business rules work in God’s kingdom?
faqs.answer: No; it doesn’t always work the way we think.

faqs.question: What picture illustrates Jeremiah 2:19?
faqs.answer: Dominoes coming back around to knock him over.

faqs.question: What harms families?
faqs.answer: Marijuana, alcohol, heroin; they cause such destruction.

faqs.question: Did he have horses?
faqs.answer: Yes; getting them to let them ride was sometimes a challenge.

faqs.question: Can we be stubborn?
faqs.answer: Yes; like horses we learn bad habits and need constant renewal.

faqs.question: What if my life fell from a tower to ground zero?
faqs.answer: God’s restoration can build you back up.

faqs.question: Why did Peter go to Cornelius?
faqs.answer: Breaking customs, because God said to be there.
